schemaNote: All hooks call the shared dispatcher, but Codex App host lifecycle E2E is not proven; App Start must report START_NOT_ENFORCED and mutation remains fail-closed.

hooks.command: sh -c 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && exec python3 "$root/scripts/harness/hook_dispatch.py" --client codex --event session-start'

sh -c 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && exec python3 "$root/scripts/harness/hook_dispatch.py" --client codex --event post-write'
sh -c 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && exec python3 "$root/scripts/harness/hook_dispatch.py" --client codex --event tool-failure'
